constraint_findings.detail: All four gate-side extracted values (qg_c, qgd_c, plateau_v) and rds_max_ohm are specified at VGS=0 to 10 V / VGS=10 V only. The campaign rule (WORKER.md: -5/+18 V numbers are not applicable at 0/+15 V) applies symmetrically: 0/+10 V charge values are not the 0/+15 V charge values. No 0/+15 V or 15 V-drive switching energy exists in this datasheet.

constraint_findings.finding: No switching-energy data at any gate bias
constraint_findings.detail: The datasheet publishes no Eon/Eoff (inductive-load switching energy) curves. Diagram 10 (VGS=f(Qgate)) and Tables 5/9 give switching times, not energies. Switching energy must come from a different source or from the maintained model.
Tj=150 degC RDS(on) is 0.077 ohm typical, no maximum and no stated 25->150 degC guarantee factor. A hot guaranteed bound is not available from this document.
